summary: Added a fleet AI agent to myseliasan: a deterministic daily "fleet digest" (typed findings computed in plain Go from event volume/baseline/fleet-health/audit signals, localized client-side into en/ms/zh/ar; scheduled at a configurable local hour, default 07:00, plus generate-now) and an optional "ask the fleet" chat (POST /api/agent/chat, SSE-streamed, strictly grounded on a <=8KiB central-data bundle citing notification/node ids). The language model is off by default (agent.llm.mode) and never in a critical path: findings and the feed entry are always produced by the deterministic narrator, and an LLM that is off, unreachable, crashed, or timing out only costs the optional prose narrative. Two LLM modes beyond off: an operator's own OpenAI-compatible endpoint ("external"), or a supervised llama.cpp llama-server child process on loopback ("sidecar", port 49540, pinned release b10289 + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M, SHA-256-verified downloads) that can also be provisioned by importing an operator-supplied build/model through the existing file picker for air-gapped sites. New stdlib-only infra/llm OpenAI-compatible chat client backs both modes. This also brought myseliasan's notification analytics substrate up to parity with mymatasan for the first time: hourly rollups (domain.NotificationRollup), a config-driven retention purge for the feed, and a new GET /api/notifications/baseline endpoint (fleet-wide only — relayed camera ids collide across nodes, so no per-camera narrowing here), all of which the digest's baseline findings and the Insight page's chart now read. New settings section "agent" in the safe-subset config editor, a new AI Insight nav page, RBAC feature toggle for /api/agent (viewers get GET by default), new myseliasan_agent_* and myseliasan_notifications_purged_total metrics, and new agent.* audit actions.
compatibility: Fully backward compatible and off by default for the new surface area: an existing myseliasan install with no agent config picks up digest.enabled=true/localHour=7/windowHours=24/retentionDays=180 and llm.mode="off" — the digest starts generating daily with no LLM involved and no operator action required; chat stays hidden until a language model is explicitly enabled. Downloading the sidecar's binary/model is gated by agent.allowDownloads (default true, i.e. available but operator-triggered only, never automatic) and the environment variable MYSELIASAN_AI_DOWNLOADS=off hard-locks that route regardless of config, matching the basemap downloader's existing env-lock contract for air-gapped sites — this is myseliasan's second deliberate internet-reaching feature, not its first. The AI sidecar's artifacts live under <dataDir>/llm and are included in factory reset. The notification rollup/purge substrate backfills existing history on first boot after upgrade rather than requiring a migration step; retention purge only deletes rows when notification.retentionDays is set (0 keeps everything, matching prior behavior of unbounded growth).
